    <abstract>In this paper, Unified approach method is proposed to construct more general precise (exact) of ill-possed Boussinesq equation. This technique can be used to obtain the soliton for the non-linear partial differential equation. This method can facilitate a deeper understanding of the wave phenomenon and also demonstrate the significance of researching different non-linear waves that occur in ocean engineering and physics. This technique has successfully provided several new solitons for ill-possed Boussinesq equation like Dark soliton, Kink shaped soliton, Periodic soliton and Dispersion-less soliton. Appropriate values are given to the parameters involved in the of the equation for graphical view of our results. Our results show the efficiency and favor-ability of unified approach method for solving other non-linear partial differential equations.</abstract>
